question: Does reducing the whole event journal on every write stay acceptable at realistic project sizes?
hypothesis: Full replay stays under 50ms for journals up to 10,000 events on the target machine.
method: Generate synthetic journals of 100, 1000 and 10000 events; measure Reduce and ProjectState rendering.
environment: Apple Silicon, 48 GB, Go 1.25, pure-Go SQLite driver, in-memory database.
result_summary: Replay is linear and well under the threshold at 10,000 events, but exceeds it near 80,000.
limitations: Measured with in-memory SQLite only; on-disk WAL was not exercised.
Synthetic events are smaller than real Work Package approvals.
